activity: People kept leaving incomplete repair messages, so I listened to the last twenty calls and wrote down which details were usually missing. I made a one-page prompt for apartment number, urgency, access times, and a photo when useful. After a week, I moved access times before the problem description because that was what delayed us most.

abilities.quote: I listened to the last twenty calls and wrote down which details were usually missing.

candidate.limitations: One self-submitted activity supports a bounded workflow-design hypothesis, not a general claim about strategic ability.

activity: Two drivers cancelled after the meal boxes were already packed. I marked every delivery that had a strict time, grouped the remaining stops by elevator buildings and walk-ups, and called three recipients whose times could move. Nobody had to take more than two extra stops, and I saved the revised route so next week's coordinator could see why it changed.

abilities.name: Constraint-aware contingency planning
abilities.observation: Replanned under sudden capacity loss by separating fixed constraints from flexible ones and distributing the burden.
abilities.quote: I marked every delivery that had a strict time, grouped the remaining stops by elevator buildings and walk-ups, and called three recipients whose times could move.
